Because texture and weight vary widely between mills, every artist interested in printing on recycled stock should bring a sample first for a quick press check.
outputs.with:
Subject: New paper options for studio printmakers

If you have been saving post-consumer stock for a project, we have good news. Our print shop accepts recycled paper starting May 8, giving local creators a practical path for greener editions. Before we queue your job, artists need to bring a sample so we can check thickness and finish.
